From National Geographic and executive producer James Cameron, OceanXplorers follows scientists and explorers aboard an advanced marine research vessel with a goal to discover our oceans’ greatest secrets. In this full episode, the team travels into the high Arctic, where they meet the bowhead whale, the longest-living mammal, and the Greenland shark, the longest-living vertebrate. How do these ice giants live so long in icy waters, and what else will the team uncover?
